currency.label: Points above replacement
currency.desc: Skill positions: EPA credited from the play-by-play (dropbacks and rushes for QBs, rushes and targets for backs and receivers, garbage time excluded) above the EPA a replacement-level player (the non-starters at the position) produces on the same plays. Defence and specialists: box-score points with documented weights above the non-starters' rate per game. Values are comparable within a position, less so across positions.
